notes.title: Patch 1.1.5
notes.content:
There have been several small patches since the release of Eternal Harvest, now on version 1.1.5
Summary of recent changes:
- Leaderboard usability improvements
- Small level generation fixes
- Eternal Harvest time bonuses are a bit larger now
- The time curse is slightly weaker now
- Projectile weapons have a lower projectile start offset now, which should make them less likely to collide with level geometry very close to the player
- Eternal Harvest score is now uploaded if the player quits the game before the run is finished

notes.title: Eternal Harvest - new game mode!
notes.content:
Calcium Contract just got a big free update, adding Eternal Harvest, a completely new game mode with new content!

In Eternal Harvest, you fight your way through procedurally generated levels that rebuild themselves as you play! It's a score-attack game mode where you can test your skills against your friends or the world.

To spice things up, there are new curse mechanics that introduce a risk and reward element: your score will increase faster, but the fight will get harder in quirky ways!

You can compare your scores to your friends and other players, and you can participate in daily challenges - each day, everybody gets the same layout but there's only one chance of getting a score.

Eternal Harvest is a completely new and super fun way of enjoying Calcium Contract!

notes.title: Update: 1.0.1
notes.content:
Calcium Contract 1.0.1 is here! This patch is addressing some player feedback:

[list]
[*] Roosters and floaters now emit idle sounds more frequently when chasing the player
[*] Sound rebalancing. Sounds should fade out a bit slower with distance and some important sounds should be a bit more audible
[*] Hitscanner enemies (cats) rebalance. They will miss a bit more when far away from the player and their deadliness doesn't scale as sharply in higher difficulties
[*] Treasures caught and clocks destroyed are now shown in the end level screen (number/total) and in the level list (all cleared indicator)
[*] Fixed a bug in Industrial District that prevented some enemies from spawning
[/list]
